notes:
Account snapshot: SilverQuill is a mid-market SaaS focused on scaling KB-driven support assistants for ecommerce customers. Heavy emphasis on embeddings + reranking pipeline; want hosted API first for speed to market.

Key goals / KPIs:
- Indexing scale: ~1.2M documents (~10M chunks after chunking & metadata).
- QPS: target 600-900 qps peak for public-facing help widget (high concurrency, short queries).
- Latency SLO: retrieval + rerank p95 < 120ms desired; p99 < 250ms acceptable with fallback.
- Cost target: <$0.003 per query end-to-end (embedding + ANN + rerank).
- Quality: reranker should improve top-1 correctness by >=15% vs dense-only baseline.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-27: Intro demo with Riley (AE) + Miguel (SE). Walked through hosted API latency profiles, caching options. (FF-20260227-3f9b)
- 2026-03-05: Deep-dive call on reranking approach; SilverQuill shared sample query set and baseline metrics. (FF-20260305-8d1a)
- 2026-03-08: Security questionnaire exchanged; SilverQuill asked for SOC2 in-scope items + residency confirmation for EU customers. Drive: pricing deck + POC spec shared.
- 2026-03-10: POC kickoff — they accepted 7-day hosted API POC. SE to provision keys, sample dataset ingestion.

Requirements / constraints (notes from calls):
- Prefer hosted_api for initial POC; want smooth path to Dedicated only if unit economics justify.
- Need SSO/SAML for admin console; audit logs and KMS integration non-negotiable for enterprise customers.
- Residency: subset of customers in EU require data residency; asking if Redwood can pin region or provide dedicated routing.
- Throughput burst: expect large diurnal spikes aligned with marketing campaigns; need autoscaling guidance and warmup strategies.

POC scope and success criteria:
- Ingest 1.2M docs (chunking rules defined in POC spec).
- Validate ANN recall at top-50 and reranker lift on an evaluation query-set (sample provided).
- Measure cost per query under configured batching/caching and compare to SilverQuill threshold.
- Demonstrate graceful degradation: fallback to lower-cost model variant under load without dropping below quality threshold.

Technical notes (SE):
- Prefer model family: open embedding models (instruction-tuned embeddings) + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-20.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations on quantization + batching to hit cost target.
- Will test client-side prefix caching for frequent queries and server-side KV caching for sessioned chat.

Quotes / paraphrases: "If we can't hit <120ms p95 at 800qps our product team won't accept the change" — Head of Product.

Next immediate actions:
- SE (Miguel) to upload ingestion manifest, set up API keys for POC by 2026-03-12.
- AE (Riley) schedule pricing review with procurement (Jordan looped) 2026-03-17.
- Security to confirm SOC2/ISO artifacts + residency approach by 2026-03-15.

Stated blockers: cost sensitivity + exec sign-off. Procurement timeline depends on POC results and a short TCO analysis comparing hosted vs Dedicated.
